setup: Five career rivals in native grid slots 0,1,2,4,5; real Career.begin field and boss setup; no player car.
simulation: Generated LAYOUTS/Track/AICar, original generated World progress/onLap and car-to-car impulses, native Track.build pad records; 120 Hz presentation and physics.

metricDefinitions.trafficImpulseEvents: Per-racer native World.kick calls, including tiny repeated contact impulses; not distinct crashes.
metricDefinitions.trafficContactFrames: Per-racer 120 Hz frames with native separation calls; not seconds or distinct collisions.
metricDefinitions.trafficContactEpisodes: Per-racer transitions from no contact to any native car separation in the next physics frame.
metricDefinitions.trafficImpulsesAbove3Mps: Per-racer impulses above the native player crash-effect boundary; descriptive only.
metricDefinitions.maxNativeStepM: Measured x/z displacement including native road correction and native car separation.
metricDefinitions.wallScrapeFrames: Native PlayerCar scrape emissions, which may repeat during sustained wall contact.

comparison.observationLimit: Unchanged 350-second maximum from the historical audit.
